content_sections.heading: IGNCA Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IGNCA Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IGNCA Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Private Secretary to Regional Director and 1 for Accounts Officer/ Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Private Secretary to Regional Director: Bachelor's degree from any recognized university. Proficiency in MS Office. Good communication skills in English & Tamil. Accounts Officer/ Project Assistant (ACCOUNTS): Graduation in any stream from any recognized college/institution. Minimum 5 years of experience in the relevant field preferably in the Government Sector. Strong communication skills with good command over Tamil & English and knowledge Accounting and GFR Norms.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Private Secretary to Regional Director: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Accounts Officer/ Project Assistant (ACCOUNTS): Maximum age limit is 62 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGNCA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Private Secretary post is scheduled for 15th September 2026. Candidates should report on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accounts Officer/Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Accounts Officer/Project Assistant post, candidates need to have a Graduation in any stream from a recognized college or institution, along with specific experience and skills.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for these recruitment drives. Candidates are advised to confirm this with the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Private Secretary to Regional Director position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Private Secretary to Regional Director position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents, self-attested photocopies of testimonials (academic mark sheets/experience certificates), and identity proof (Aadhar card/Pan Card/Driving license/Voter-Id).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Private Secretary to Regional Director post is Rs. 20,000/- per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is being held at Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA), Puducherry, 605004.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What are the required communication skills for the Private Secretary role?
faq.answer: Good communication skills in both English and Tamil are required for the Private Secretary role.
